cards.prompt: Register a service interface IOrderService and implementation OrderService in Program.cs so a new instance is created once per HTTP request.
cards.explanation: AddScoped creates one instance per client HTTP request, making it the standard lifetime for services using DbContext.

cards.prompt: Register IAppCache / MemoryAppCache in Program.cs so a single shared instance lives for the entire application lifetime.
cards.explanation: AddSingleton creates one instance on first request (or at registration) and reuses it across all threads and requests.

cards.prompt: Register a lightweight stateless helper IEmailFormatter / HtmlEmailFormatter in Program.cs so a brand-new instance is created every time it is injected.
cards.explanation: AddTransient creates a fresh object every time the service is requested from the DI container.

cards.prompt: Write the exact 3 middleware calls in Program.cs in their mandatory execution order for endpoint routing, identity authentication, and role/policy authorization.
cards.explanation: UseRouting must resolve the endpoint first, UseAuthentication identifies the user principal, and UseAuthorization enforces access rules before endpoint execution.

cards.prompt: Write the two attributes placed above a POST Create(ProductViewModel vm) controller action to restrict HTTP verbs and prevent CSRF attacks.
cards.explanation: [HttpPost] restricts the action to POST requests, and [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] verifies the hidden antiforgery token emitted by Razor forms.

cards.prompt: Restrict an entire ProductsController so only authenticated users in the 'Admin' role can access any of its actions.
cards.explanation: Applying [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")] at the controller class level protects all actions unless overridden with [AllowAnonymous].

cards.prompt: Which attribute allows unauthenticated visitors to access a specific Login action inside a controller decorated with [Authorize]?
cards.explanation: [AllowAnonymous] bypasses authorization checks for that specific action method.

cards.prompt: In an MVC controller action, what return call sends HTTP 404 when a queried entity ID is not found in the database?
cards.explanation: NotFound() returns a NotFoundResult (HTTP 404).

cards.prompt: After a successful POST Create or Edit in MVC (Post-Redirect-Get pattern), how do you redirect to the Index action of the same controller?
cards.explanation: Post-Redirect-Get prevents duplicate form submissions if the user refreshes the browser.

cards.prompt: In OnModelCreating, configure a unique database index on the Sku property of entity Product using Fluent API (parameter 'b').
cards.explanation: HasIndex(...).IsUnique() enforces uniqueness at the relational database schema level.

cards.prompt: In EF Core Fluent API, what DeleteBehavior prevents deleting a parent Category if child Products still reference it?
cards.explanation: DeleteBehavior.Restrict disables cascade delete so the database throws a foreign key constraint error if dependent rows exist.

cards.prompt: Write the asynchronous EF Core call to materialize a query 'query' into a List<T>.
cards.explanation: ToListAsync() executes the SQL query asynchronously without blocking the ASP.NET Core thread pool.

cards.prompt: Write the asynchronous EF Core call on _context.Products to look up an entity by its primary key 'id' (checks change tracker first).
cards.explanation: FindAsync checks the DbContext in-memory identity map before querying the database.

cards.prompt: Write a Razor <input> tag bound to the model property 'Price' with class 'form-control'.
cards.explanation: asp-for generates the id, name, value, and unobtrusive validation data-* attributes from the model property.

cards.prompt: Write a Razor <span> tag that displays field-level validation errors for model property 'Price' with class 'text-danger'.
cards.explanation: asp-validation-for renders ModelState errors associated with the specified property.

cards.prompt: Write a Razor <div> tag that displays model-level (non-property-specific) validation errors with class 'text-danger'.
cards.explanation: ValidationSummary.ModelOnly shows errors keyed to string.Empty without duplicating individual field errors.

cards.prompt: Write the Data Annotation attribute that restricts a string property to a maximum length of 100 characters.
cards.explanation: [StringLength(100)] enforces both client/server model validation and nvarchar(100) schema generation in EF Core.

cards.prompt: Write the Data Annotation attribute that constrains a decimal Price property between 0.01 and 9999.99.
cards.explanation: [Range(min, max)] validates inclusive numeric bounds during model binding.

cards.prompt: Write the Data Annotation attribute that sets the label text of a ViewModel property 'FirstName' to 'First Name'.
cards.explanation: <label asp-for="FirstName"> reads the Display Name attribute automatically.

cards.prompt: Write the attribute route template on an action method to match GET requests with an integer route parameter 'id' (e.g., /products/details/5).
cards.explanation: Route constraints like {id:int} reject non-integer segments before invoking the controller action.
